text: Security is a key part of web development. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server. Second, authentication helps confirm that users are who they say they are, often through passwords or two-factor methods. Third, input validation checks the data users send, so harmful code cannot enter your system. Developers must also learn about common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which can damage a website or steal information. By following these basic steps, you can build safer applications and protect both your users and your data from common online threats.
